# Motion Sensor Range domain

## Overview
**Id:** blk-59db01f0a30a

Motion Sensor Range makes the detection range of the vanilla Duplicant Motion Sensor (`LogicDuplicantSensorConfig`) adjustable from a slider in the building's side screen. It adds no building of its own: it bolts one component onto the vanilla prefab and rewrites the sensor's detection area at runtime. The range runs from 2 to 16 tiles in steps of 2, with 4 as the vanilla default.

## Key Entities
**Id:** blk-6d0612f31e83

### RangeSlider
**Id:** blk-1d5bba6bb234  
**Tags:** game-component, side-screen, saved-state, reflection  
**Description**: The component that holds the chosen range, exposes it to the game's int-slider side screen, and applies it to the sensor.  
**Location**: `src/MotionSensorRange/RangeSlider.cs`

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| range | int (`[Serialize]`) | The chosen range in tiles; saved with the building (opt-in `KSerialization`) |
| MinRange / MaxRange / DefaultRange | const int | 2, 16 and 4 |
| copyBuildingSettings | `CopyBuildingSettings` (`[MyCmpAdd]`) | Puts the motion sensor into the vanilla copy-settings tool, which the vanilla building lacks |
| sensor | `LogicDuplicantSensor` (`[MyCmpGet]`) | The vanilla sensor whose `pickupRange` and scene-partitioner entry the component rewrites |
| visualizer | `RangeVisualizer` (`[MyCmpGet]`) | The range overlay, resized to the new area |
| rotatable | `Rotatable` (`[MyCmpGet]`) | Rotates the detection offset for a sensor facing sideways |

**Relationships**: Implements `IIntSliderControl` (the game's current slider interface). Sits beside `LogicDuplicantSensor` on the same game object. Reads and writes the sensor's private `pickupableExtents`, `pickupablesChangedEntry`, `pickupablesDirty`, `OnPickupablesChanged` and `RefreshReachableCells` through cached Harmony `AccessTools` reflection.

### Harmony patches
**Id:** blk-c493a6cf7733  
**Tags:** harmony-patching, under-construction-building  
**Location**: `src/MotionSensorRange/Patches.cs`

| Patch target | Kind | Purpose |
|--------------|------|---------|
| `LogicDuplicantSensorConfig.DoPostConfigureComplete` | Postfix | `AddOrGet<RangeSlider>()` on the finished building prefab |
| `GeneratedBuildings.LoadGeneratedBuildings` | Postfix | Adds `RangeSlider` to the sensor's under-construction prefab, so the range can be preset before the building is finished |
| `Constructable.FinishConstruction` | Postfix | Copies the range from the construction site's `RangeSlider` to the finished building found in the same cell on the building's object layer |

### Mod entry and strings
**Id:** blk-4592ab5d1abc  
**Tags:** mod-entry-point, mod-strings  
**Location**: `src/MotionSensorRange/Mod.cs`, `src/MotionSensorRange/ModStrings.cs`, `src/MotionSensorRange/translations/`
`MotionSensorRangeMod` (a `UserMod2`) registers `ModStrings` through `Isochronous.Translations` (see `common/`). The three strings (title, tooltip, slider tooltip) live under `STRINGS.UI.UISIDESCREENS.MOTION_SENSOR_RANGE_SIDE_SCREEN`; Chinese, Korean and Russian come from `translations/<locale>.po`.

### Saved state and settings
**Id:** blk-ef8a1b1dc448  
**Tags:** saved-state

There is one saved value, `RangeSlider.range`, stored with each motion sensor. The mod has no options screen and no config file. Mod id: `Isochronous.MotionSensorRange` (`src/MotionSensorRange/mod.yaml`).

## Business Rules
**Id:** blk-129735a5fffc  
**Tags:** saved-state, copy-settings, under-construction-building, vanilla-fallback

- The range is 2 to 16 tiles; any value the slider sends is rounded to the nearest even number and clamped (`SetSliderValue`). The scan area spans range/2 tiles to each side and is only symmetric for even ranges.
- The default is 4, the vanilla range, so an untouched sensor behaves exactly as in the base game.
- A new range takes effect at once: the sensor's `pickupRange`, its scene-partitioner registration, its reachable-cell refresh and the range overlay all follow it.
- The range is saved with the building and re-applied on spawn and after deserialization, because `LogicDuplicantSensor.OnSpawn` registers with the default range first.
- Copy settings between motion sensors copies the range. A range set on the building under construction carries over when construction completes.
- If a game update renames the sensor's private members, the mod logs one warning and the range setting has no effect; it does not throw.

## Key Code Paths
**Id:** blk-63f43343ddcb  
**Tags:** copy-settings, under-construction-building, in-game-testing

- **Slider change**: side screen calls `SetSliderValue`, which snaps and clamps, then `ApplyRange` — see `src/MotionSensorRange/RangeSlider.cs`
- **Applying a range**: `ApplyRange` mirrors the extents math of `LogicDuplicantSensor.OnSpawn`, frees and re-adds the `pickupablesChangedLayer` partitioner entry, marks pickupables dirty, refreshes reachable cells and resizes the visualizer — see `src/MotionSensorRange/RangeSlider.cs`
- **Construction carry-over**: `Constructable.FinishConstruction` postfix calls `CopyRangeFrom` — see `src/MotionSensorRange/Patches.cs`
- **Copy settings**: `GameHashes.CopySettings` event handled by `OnCopySettings` — see `src/MotionSensorRange/RangeSlider.cs`
- **Tests**: in-game `[OniTest]` cases in `src/MotionSensorRange.Tests/` (`Range.cs` for defaults, snapping, detection area, rotation and copy settings; `Detection.cs` for a Duplicant at distance and the side screen; `Persistence.cs` for save/load and construction carry-over)

## Related
**Id:** blk-eebe4207ea1d

- See also: [glossary](glossary.md)

# Motion Sensor Range glossary

Terms for the Motion Sensor Range mod. For the code behind them, see [entities](entities.md).

## Abbreviations and Acronyms
**Id:** blk-48c7b28388ed

| Abbreviation | Full Term | Context |
|--------------|-----------|---------|
| ONI | Oxygen Not Included | The game this mod targets |
| MSR | Motion Sensor Range | Prefix of the in-game test names in `src/MotionSensorRange.Tests/` |
| U59 | Game update 59 | The build the private sensor member names were verified against (744825), noted in `RangeSlider.cs` |

## Terms to Avoid
**Id:** blk-07a7f0531608

| Avoid | Use Instead | Reason |
|-------|-------------|--------|
| Radius | Range | The setting and its strings say "range"; the area is a box that spans range/2 tiles to each side, not a circle |
| Odd range | Even range | Odd values are never stored; the slider snaps to even tiles |

## Cross-Domain Terms
**Id:** blk-251c889f4fbe

### Duplicant Motion Sensor
**Id:** blk-f46163b8d190  
**Definition**: The vanilla automation sensor (`LogicDuplicantSensorConfig`, component `LogicDuplicantSensor`) that sends a green signal while a Duplicant is within its detection area.  
**Used in**: `Patches.cs`, `RangeSlider.cs`

### pickupRange
**Id:** blk-24c040f93193  
**Definition**: The `LogicDuplicantSensor` field holding the sensor's range in tiles; vanilla value 4. The mod sets it from the slider.  
**Used in**: `RangeSlider.ApplyRange`

### Scene partitioner
**Id:** blk-72a80114ee4c  
**Definition**: The game's spatial index (`GameScenePartitioner`). The sensor registers a rectangular `Extents` on the `pickupablesChangedLayer` so it hears when Duplicants move in its area; the mod frees and re-registers that entry when the range changes.  
**Used in**: `RangeSlider.ApplyRange`

### Extents
**Id:** blk-c94337e951ad  
**Definition**: The game's rectangle of grid cells, built here from a centre cell and range/2.  
**Used in**: `RangeSlider.ApplyRange`

### RangeVisualizer
**Id:** blk-ebf6560d4c1c  
**Definition**: The vanilla component that draws the building's range outline on the map; the mod sets its `RangeMin` and `RangeMax` to match the range.  
**Used in**: `RangeSlider.ApplyRange`

### IIntSliderControl
**Id:** blk-444be195218b  
**Tags:** side-screen  
**Definition**: The game's current interface for a building that wants an integer slider in its side screen. An older slider interface (`ISliderControl`) changed shape and broke the earlier mod this one replaces.  
**Used in**: `RangeSlider`

### Copy settings
**Id:** blk-129a4f1ab384  
**Tags:** copy-settings  
**Definition**: The vanilla tool (mirror button, drag tool) that copies a building's settings to others of its kind, via the `CopySettings` game event and a `CopyBuildingSettings` component.  
**Used in**: `RangeSlider.OnCopySettings`

### Under-construction building
**Id:** blk-7f02101a4db9  
**Tags:** under-construction-building  
**Definition**: The placeholder object (`BuildingUnderConstruction`) a building is while Duplicants build it; `Constructable.FinishConstruction` replaces it with the finished building.  
**Used in**: `Patches.cs`

### KSerialization
**Id:** blk-7a1f7be29747  
**Tags:** saved-state  
**Definition**: The game's save serializer; `[Serialize]` fields on a `[SerializationConfig(MemberSerialization.OptIn)]` component are saved with the building.  
**Used in**: `RangeSlider.range`

## Related
**Id:** blk-631e5fafb8e2

- See also: [entities](entities.md)

# motion-sensor-range

## What this is
**Id:** blk-38f9329ac7bb

Motion Sensor Range is an Oxygen Not Included mod that makes the detection range of the vanilla Duplicant Motion Sensor adjustable from a slider in the building's side screen: 2 to 16 tiles in steps of 2, default 4 (the vanilla range). It adds no building of its own. A `RangeSlider` component is attached to the sensor prefab by a Harmony postfix and rewrites the sensor's detection area at runtime; the range is saved with the building, works with the vanilla copy-settings tool, and carries over from an under-construction building. It is a from-scratch rewrite of Cairath's Configurable Motion Sensor Range for the current game. Version 1.2.0 is released on the Steam Workshop (id 3804025857); `mod.yaml` sets `supportedContent: ALL` and `minimumSupportedBuild: 744825`, so it loads with every DLC.

## Where things are
**Id:** blk-2ddb429ef268

- `src/MotionSensorRange/`: the mod. `Mod.cs` (entry point), `Patches.cs` (Harmony patches on the motion sensor config and construction), `RangeSlider.cs` (the component), `ModStrings.cs` (text registered under the game's STRINGS tree), `mod.yaml` and `mod_info.yaml` (game manifests), `translations/` (`.pot` template plus `ko.po`, `ru.po`, `zh.po`).
- `src/MotionSensorRange.Tests/`: in-game tests for detection, persistence and range (`Detection.cs`, `Persistence.cs`, `Range.cs`).
- `assets-src/`: preview art sources and `PreviewGen/`, the small program that renders the Workshop preview.
- `publish/`: Workshop material (`workshop-description.txt`, `workshop-id.txt`, `preview.png`, and `obsolete-description.txt` for the retired earlier upload).
- `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`: user-facing description and release history.
- `.context/` holds `overview.md` (this file), `domains/` (entities and glossary), `standards/` (code style, error handling, naming conventions), `decisions/`, `retrospectives/`, `projects.md` and `META.md`.

# Code Style Guide

## Formatting
**Id:** blk-9d346420b869

### Indentation
**Id:** blk-b18c58d2f355

- Tabs, one per level, in every `.cs` file (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Project files (`.csproj`, `common/oni-mod.props`, `common/oni-mod.targets`) use two spaces.
- Files are committed with LF line endings; Windows checkouts convert them to CRLF (`core.autocrlf` is true), so do not hand-normalise line endings.

### Line Length
**Id:** blk-a24a70111ef7

- No limit is configured and the repository has no `.editorconfig`.
- Wrap long calls and string concatenations after an argument or before a `+`, and indent the continuation one tab. The start-up log call in `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Mod.cs` is the pattern.
- TODO(owner): decide whether to add an `.editorconfig` recording tabs and brace placement so editors enforce what the code already does.

### Braces
**Id:** blk-def075106b14

- Opening brace on its own line (Allman) for namespaces, types, members and multi-line control blocks.
- A body of one short statement goes on the next line without braces:

```csharp
foreach (Mod mod in mods)
{
	if (!mod.IsEnabledForActiveDlc())
		continue;
	...
}
```

- Multi-line initialisers and enums end with a trailing comma (`YieldToWorkshopIds` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`, `CoolPodMode` in `mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/Options.cs`).

## Language and Toolchain
**Id:** blk-cac7d95e1fac

- C# 9 on .NET Framework 4.8 (`LangVersion` 9.0 and `TargetFramework` net48 in `common/oni-mod.props`). Namespace blocks, not file-scoped namespaces; no nullable reference types.
- Mods compile against the game's own assemblies (`common/oni-mod.targets`): `Assembly-CSharp`, `Assembly-CSharp-firstpass`, `0Harmony` and Unity modules. The game's .NET Framework lacks some newer APIs (`ConditionalWeakTable.AddOrUpdate` is missing, see `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`).
- Optional references are switched on in the mod csproj before the targets import: `ReferenceUnityUI`, `ReferenceImageConversion`, `UsePLib` (PLib is ILRepack-merged into the mod DLL) and `UseTranslations` (compiles `common/src/Translations.cs` in).
- One namespace per mod, equal to its `RootNamespace`. Subfolders organise files and do not add namespaces (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Plan`, `Rules`, `Tool`, `UI` all declare `namespace UpgradePlanner`).

## Imports/Includes
**Id:** blk-49b0c41a5de8

### Organization
**Id:** blk-5290766c841f

`using` directives sit above the namespace, in one block with no blank lines, sorted alphabetically with `System.*` first. Aliases for `ModStrings` branches come last.

1. `System.*`
2. Everything else alphabetically: `HarmonyLib`, `Isochronous`, `KMod`, `Newtonsoft.Json`, `PeterHan.PLib.*`, `ProcGenGame`, `UnityEngine`
3. Aliases (`using TOOL = SweepZones.ModStrings.UI.TOOLS.SWEEPZONES;`)

### Example
**Id:** blk-5379b7234d12

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Reflection;
using HarmonyLib;
using Isochronous;
using Klei;
using KMod;
using STRINGS;
using UnityEngine;
```
(`mods/salty-surf/src/SaltySurf/Mod.cs`)

`Debug.Log` resolves either to `UnityEngine.Debug` or to the game's own global `Debug` class, so several `Mod.cs` files omit `using UnityEngine`. When a file imports `System.Diagnostics`, qualify the call as `UnityEngine.Debug.Log` (`mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`).

## Comments
**Id:** blk-ee0c232b2f60

### When to Comment
**Id:** blk-40ac288e819d

- On every non-trivial class, an XML `<summary>` that says what the game does and what the patch changes, so a reader can check the patch against the game code. The long summary on `OvercrowdingMonitor_UpdateRegion_Patch` in `mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails/src/DontCountEggsOnRails/Mod.cs` is the model.
- Where a game quirk forces an odd line: `// The game's .NET Framework has no AddOrUpdate on this table.`
- Where another mod is involved, name it and its Workshop id (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`, `mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Mod.cs`).
- Escape angle brackets in XML comments as `<` and `>`.

### When NOT to Comment
**Id:** blk-26d6296bb90f

- Code that reads clearly from its names.
- Commented-out code; delete it.
- Restating what a line does.

### Format
**Id:** blk-fd526fc7dd55

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// The "Any" choice. It is a tag like the elements a sensor's Filterable holds, so it rides
/// in the same saved field and copies with the building's settings.
/// </summary>
public static class AnyElement

// Single-line note for a quirk or a reason.
```

## Control Structures
**Id:** blk-b85a4aa83150

### Conditionals
**Id:** blk-01abe9cbf8da

Guard clauses and early `return` or `continue` keep nesting shallow (`SettleSimBackwalls.UpdateFromSim` in `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/SettleSimPatch.cs`):

```csharp
if (!Grid.IsValidCell(cell))
	continue;
ushort idx = data->backwallElement[cell];
if (idx == ushort.MaxValue || idx >= elements.Count)
	continue;
```

### Loops
**Id:** blk-16cd4984fdb3

- Plain `for` and `foreach`. Code that runs every sim tick or frame avoids LINQ and allocations; reuse scratch lists (`scratch` in `mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`).
- Local types are written out (`Tech tech = ...`). `var` appears mainly in `mods/upgrade-planner`, `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere` and the test projects; follow the surrounding file.

### Strings
**Id:** blk-3bed2e8b7fac  
**Tags:** mod-strings, logging

- Log and UI text is built with `+` concatenation, or `string.Format` on a `LocString`. String interpolation is not used in mod code.
- Player-visible text is a `LocString` field in `ModStrings`, never a literal at the call site (see [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)).

## Harmony Patches
**Id:** blk-183bc6e8000f  
**Tags:** harmony-patching, mod-entry-point, reflection

- A patch is a static class with `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(Type), nameof(Type.Method))]`, or `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(Type), "PrivateMethod")]` for a non-public method, and methods named `Prefix`, `Postfix`, `Transpiler` or `Finalizer` (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`).
- Game state arrives through Harmony parameters: `__instance`, `__result`, `___field`. Fields read repeatedly use `AccessTools.FieldRefAccess` kept in a `static readonly` field (`mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`).
- A prefix returns `true` to let the game's method run and `false` only when it replaces the method (`mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails`, `mods/bitshifter` `UpdateVisuals`).
- A patch that depends on an option implements `Prepare()` (`mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Patches.cs`); a patch with several targets implements `TargetMethods()`.
- `UserMod2.OnLoad` calls `base.OnLoad(harmony)`, which applies every patch in the assembly, then registers libraries and logs the version. A mod that must patch after all others applies its patches from `OnAllModsLoaded` instead (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Transpilers search for the instruction they change and report when it is not found; see [error handling](error-handling.md).

## Game Components
**Id:** blk-9213f30d4abe  
**Tags:** game-component, saved-state

- A component extends `KMonoBehaviour`, overrides `OnPrefabInit`, `OnSpawn` and `OnCleanUp` and calls `base` from each. Sibling components come in through `[MyCmpGet]` or `[MyCmpReq]` (`mods/no-magic-fridges/src/NoMagicFridges/FridgeThermostat.cs`).
- Saved state uses `[Serialize]` fields with `[SerializationConfig(MemberSerialization.OptIn)]` on the class (`mods/sweep-zones/src/SweepZones/ZoneStore.cs`).
- Components are added to prefabs from a `DoPostConfigureComplete` postfix with `go.AddOrGet<T>()`.

## Project-Specific Rules
**Id:** blk-f4dd752ab3b9  
**Tags:** logging, in-game-testing, mod-strings

- Mod options are a PLib `POptions` class marked `[JsonObject(MemberSerialization.OptIn)]` and `[ConfigFile(SharedConfigLocation: true)]`, read through a static `Load()` (`mods/vent-freeze-fix/src/VentFreezeFix/Options.cs`) or through `SingletonOptions<Options>` (`mods/storage-pod-redux`). Option titles are string-table keys, so the translation follows the language.
- Every mod logs one line at load: `[<Name>] Loaded version <assembly version>`.
- Tests live in a separate `<Name>.Tests` project and are written as `[OniTest]` coroutines against the real game.

### Motion Sensor Range specifics
**Id:** blk-2a165385de59  
**Tags:** game-component, side-screen, copy-settings, harmony-patching

- `UseTranslations` only; no PLib. `Mod.cs` has no `using UnityEngine`, so `Debug` is the game's global class.
- `RangeSlider` is the component and the `IIntSliderControl` for the side screen; `range` is `[Serialize]` so it saves with the building. `CopyRangeFrom` serves the copy-settings tool and construction completion (`src/MotionSensorRange/RangeSlider.cs`).
- Patches (`Patches.cs`): `GeneratedBuildings.LoadGeneratedBuildings`, `Constructable.FinishConstruction`, `LogicDuplicantSensorConfig.DoPostConfigureComplete`.
- `assets-src/` holds a preview generator program outside the mod's `src`.

## Related
**Id:** blk-2cc5e7ead9a7

- See also: [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)
- See also: [error handling](error-handling.md)

## Formatting
**Id:** blk-9d346420b869

sections.title: Indentation
sections.text:
### Indentation
**Id:** blk-b18c58d2f355

- Tabs, one per level, in every `.cs` file (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Project files (`.csproj`, `common/oni-mod.props`, `common/oni-mod.targets`) use two spaces.
- Files are committed with LF line endings; Windows checkouts convert them to CRLF (`core.autocrlf` is true), so do not hand-normalise line endings.

sections.title: Line Length
sections.text:
### Line Length
**Id:** blk-a24a70111ef7

- No limit is configured and the repository has no `.editorconfig`.
- Wrap long calls and string concatenations after an argument or before a `+`, and indent the continuation one tab. The start-up log call in `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Mod.cs` is the pattern.
- TODO(owner): decide whether to add an `.editorconfig` recording tabs and brace placement so editors enforce what the code already does.

sections.title: Braces
Language and Toolchain
sections.text:
## Language and Toolchain
**Id:** blk-cac7d95e1fac

- C# 9 on .NET Framework 4.8 (`LangVersion` 9.0 and `TargetFramework` net48 in `common/oni-mod.props`). Namespace blocks, not file-scoped namespaces; no nullable reference types.
- Mods compile against the game's own assemblies (`common/oni-mod.targets`): `Assembly-CSharp`, `Assembly-CSharp-firstpass`, `0Harmony` and Unity modules. The game's .NET Framework lacks some newer APIs (`ConditionalWeakTable.AddOrUpdate` is missing, see `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`).
- Optional references are switched on in the mod csproj before the targets import: `ReferenceUnityUI`, `ReferenceImageConversion`, `UsePLib` (PLib is ILRepack-merged into the mod DLL) and `UseTranslations` (compiles `common/src/Translations.cs` in).
- One namespace per mod, equal to its `RootNamespace`. Subfolders organise files and do not add namespaces (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Plan`, `Rules`, `Tool`, `UI` all declare `namespace UpgradePlanner`).

sections.title: Imports/Includes
sections.text:
## Imports/Includes
**Id:** blk-49b0c41a5de8

sections.title: Organization
sections.text:
### Organization
**Id:** blk-5290766c841f

`using` directives sit above the namespace, in one block with no blank lines, sorted alphabetically with `System.*` first. Aliases for `ModStrings` branches come last.

1. `System.*`
2. Everything else alphabetically: `HarmonyLib`, `Isochronous`, `KMod`, `Newtonsoft.Json`, `PeterHan.PLib.*`, `ProcGenGame`, `UnityEngine`
3. Aliases (`using TOOL = SweepZones.ModStrings.UI.TOOLS.SWEEPZONES;`)

sections.title: When to Comment
sections.text:
### When to Comment
**Id:** blk-40ac288e819d

- On every non-trivial class, an XML `<summary>` that says what the game does and what the patch changes, so a reader can check the patch against the game code. The long summary on `OvercrowdingMonitor_UpdateRegion_Patch` in `mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails/src/DontCountEggsOnRails/Mod.cs` is the model.
- Where a game quirk forces an odd line: `// The game's .NET Framework has no AddOrUpdate on this table.`
- Where another mod is involved, name it and its Workshop id (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`, `mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Mod.cs`).
- Escape angle brackets in XML comments as `<` and `>`.

sections.title: When NOT to Comment
sections.text:
### When NOT to Comment
**Id:** blk-26d6296bb90f

- Code that reads clearly from its names.
- Commented-out code; delete it.
- Restating what a line does.

documents.text:
---
doc_id: doc-fa8916defd23
description: "Error handling conventions for Motion Sensor Range: guarding patches, try/catch cases, logging levels and anti-patterns, plus its null checks in `ApplyRange`, one-time warning and `CopyRangeFrom` guards"
applies_to:
  - "src/**"
---

# Error Handling Conventions

## Principles
**Id:** blk-85618c9841c5  
**Tags:** vanilla-fallback, logging, reflection, harmony-patching

1. **Never break the game for a mod's sake.** A patch that cannot do its job leaves the vanilla behaviour in place and says so in the log. It does not throw into the game's update loop.
2. **Check what you patch.** Game updates rename fields and move code. Every reflection lookup, transpiler match and prefab or tech lookup is checked for a miss.
3. **Say what degraded.** A warning names the thing that was not found and the consequence, so a bug report with `Player.log` is enough to diagnose.
4. **Don't swallow.** A `catch` logs and either returns a safe default or continues; it is never empty.
5. **Log at the right level.** `Debug.Log` for start-up and summaries, `Debug.LogWarning` for degraded behaviour, `Debug.LogError` for a failed player action.

There is no custom exception hierarchy. Mods are small patches over game code, so errors are handled where they occur.

## Guarding Patches
**Id:** blk-a05f11350382

### Missing member: warn, leave vanilla
**Id:** blk-0490b4fe2728  
**Tags:** reflection, vanilla-fallback, harmony-patching

A reflection lookup that returns null is checked before use. The patch then does nothing, or returns `true` from a prefix so the game's method runs.

```csharp
if (ActiveField == null || StorageField == null)
	return true; // the game renamed its fields: leave vanilla alone rather than throw
```
(`mods/no-magic-fridges/src/NoMagicFridges/Patches.cs`; the warning is logged once at load by `SimTransferMethod` in `FridgeThermostat.cs`.)

### Transpiler: count the match
**Id:** blk-e8712dfdb1c4  
**Tags:** harmony-patching, vanilla-fallback, logging

A transpiler counts the instructions it replaced. Zero (or more than expected) logs a warning and returns the original code, so a game update disables the change instead of breaking the method.

```csharp
if (swapped == 0)
	Debug.LogWarning("[CornerBuildAnything] " + where + " does not load OffsetGroups.InvertedStandardTable; corner reach not applied there");
```
(`mods/corner-build-anything/src/CornerBuildAnything/ReachTablePatches.cs`; same pattern in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs` and `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/SettleSimPatch.cs`.)

### Missing data: warn, continue
**Id:** blk-0ec0eff52bb1  
**Tags:** vanilla-fallback, logging

A build-menu, tech or asset lookup that finds nothing warns and keeps the mod working:

```csharp
Tech tech = Db.Get().Techs.TryGet(TechId);
if (tech == null)
{
	Debug.LogWarning("[SmartWeightPlate] Tech '" + TechId + "' not found; building will be unlocked from the start");
	return;
}
```
(`mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Patches.cs`; also `mods/multichannel-critter-sensor`, `mods/storage-pod-redux`.) Missing art or a missing vanilla prefab degrades the same way (`Display.UseAnim` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`, `mods/multichannel-critter-sensor/src/MultichannelCritterSensor/MultichannelCritterSensorSideScreen.cs`).

### Null checks on game objects
**Id:** blk-00c50af2c97d  
**Tags:** vanilla-fallback

Components and arguments that can be absent are tested before use: `if (stt == null || !Sim.IsValidHandle(stt.SimHandle)) return true;`, `if (sensor == null || GameScenePartitioner.Instance == null) return;` (`mods/motion-sensor-range/src/MotionSensorRange/RangeSlider.cs`).

### Warn once
**Id:** blk-542b027cee07  
**Tags:** logging

Work that repeats every frame or tick warns once behind a flag (`warnedMissingInternals` in `RangeSlider.cs`).

## try/catch
**Id:** blk-96ea55e00f65  
**Tags:** logging, reflection

`try`/`catch (Exception e)` is used in four situations and nowhere else:

1. **Optional integration with another mod.** Patching or reading another mod's types may fail for any reason. Log the message and skip the integration (`BetterAutomationOverlayCompat.Apply` in `mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Mod.cs`; `mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Compat/BlueprintsCompat.cs`).
2. **File and JSON reads and writes.** Return an empty or null result (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Plan/Presets.cs`, `mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/ModDetection.cs`, `mods/sweep-zones/src/SweepZones/ToolIcon.cs`).
3. **Patches that run inside worldgen or per-cell work**, where an escaping exception kills a thread or a whole pass (`mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/FeaturePatch.cs`, `PlanetoidPatch.cs`, `Patches.cs`, `Census.cs`).
4. **Per-job work in a queue**, so one failure does not stop the rest (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Tool/PlacementQueue.cs`, logged with `Debug.LogError`).

The message form is `"[<Name>] <what was skipped>: " + e.Message`. Use `e.GetBaseException().Message` when the exception may be a reflection wrapper, and the full `e` when the stack trace is needed.

### Finalizer for a thread with no handler
**Id:** blk-b4dcd0fc6c98  
**Tags:** harmony-patching

`Cluster.BeginGeneration` is the worldgen thread body and has none; an exception ends the thread and the loading screen waits forever. A finalizer reports the failure through the game's own error path and logs the exception (`Cluster_BeginGeneration_Patch` in `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/WorldgenThreadPatch.cs`).

## Yielding to Other Mods
**Id:** blk-adb84ed7ee3e

When another mod already does the job or shares an id, the mod steps aside and logs why:
- Bitshifter disables itself when Digital CPU is enabled or the contested methods already have Harmony owners (`WhyYield` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Storage Pod Redux does not register its buildings while the original Storage Pod is enabled, and logs a warning telling the player to disable one (`mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/Mod.cs`).

## Logging
**Id:** blk-6c3e4debe981

### Log Levels
**Id:** blk-60dc75d735e6  
**Tags:** logging

| Level | Use For | Example |
|-------|---------|---------|
| `Debug.LogError` | A player action failed and was abandoned | `PlacementQueue` in `mods/upgrade-planner` |
| `Debug.LogWarning` | Degraded or skipped behaviour | the examples above |
| `Debug.Log` | Load line, a one-line summary of what a pass changed | `Tagged N refined metal(s)` in `mods/refined-building` |

### What to Include
**Id:** blk-2c4525433225  
**Tags:** logging

- The `[<ModName>] ` prefix on every line; `JumperBridgesMod.LogPrefix` holds it for that mod.
- What was expected, what was found, and what the mod does instead.
- Cell numbers, building names and element ids when they identify the case (`mods/vent-freeze-fix`).
- Per-tick or per-frame telemetry only behind a debug option (`VentFreezeWatcher.Verbose`, `DebugSave.Enabled`) or capped (`DetailLines` in `SettleSimPatch.cs`).

PLib's `PUtil.Log*` helpers are not used; all mods log through `Debug`.

## Anti-Patterns to Avoid
**Id:** blk-d217b1718680

### Swallowing exceptions
**Id:** blk-a59c48ae7d35  
**Tags:** logging

An empty `catch` hides a broken patch. The one `catch` that returns a fallback without a log is `GuessLanguageCode` in `common/src/Translations.cs`, because a missing language preference is the normal case before the game has started.

### Throwing from a patch
**Id:** blk-912a3a5fa34f  
**Tags:** harmony-patching

An exception in a prefix or postfix on a per-frame or sim method repeats every frame. Guard, log once, return.

### Assuming the game's internals
**Id:** blk-2c929231f375  
**Tags:** reflection, harmony-patching, vanilla-fallback

Reading a private field by name without a null check on the `FieldInfo`, or replacing an instruction without confirming it was found, breaks on the next game update.

### Silent degradation
**Id:** blk-2b5456562299  
**Tags:** logging

Doing nothing without a log line leaves a player and the author guessing. Every skipped path logs.

### Spamming the log
**Id:** blk-0ca74009af40  
**Tags:** logging

A warning inside an update method fires thousands of times. Use a once-flag.

## Project-Specific Patterns
**Id:** blk-4c79ad3d6c2d

### Motion Sensor Range specifics
**Id:** blk-8cd3b544ef00  
**Tags:** detection-range, vanilla-fallback, copy-settings, reflection

- `ApplyRange` returns when `sensor` or `GameScenePartitioner.Instance` is null. If the sensor's private fields cannot be found (`SensorInternalsFound` false) it logs one warning (`warnedMissingInternals`) and the range setting has no effect until the mod is updated.
- `CopyRangeFrom` ignores a null source and a source with the same range, and applies the value only when the building has spawned (`isSpawned`).

## Related
**Id:** blk-4a81c13345b4

- See also: [code style](code-style.md)
- See also: [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)

documents.text:
---
doc_id: doc-6d1db2ae5a52
description: "Naming conventions for Motion Sensor Range: files, namespaces, variables, methods, patch classes, `ModStrings` keys and ids, plus its side screen string branch, test classes, log prefix and `staticID`"
applies_to:
  - "src/**"
---

# Naming Conventions

## Files and Directories
**Id:** blk-8205431a2930

### General Rules
**Id:** blk-eb9606adb12e

- A mod lives in `mods/<kebab-case-name>/` (`natural-backwalls-everywhere`, `just-fall-already`).
- Its code is under `mods/<name>/src/<PascalName>/` with a matching `src/<PascalName>.Tests/` project. `AssemblyName`, `RootNamespace` and the project folder share one PascalCase name (`DontCountEggsOnRails`).
- C# files are PascalCase and named for the main type they hold. One concept per file; small related types may share a file (`Display` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`).
- Release tags are `<mod-folder>-v<version>` (repository README).

### Examples by Type
**Id:** blk-01b48de8fa57  
**Tags:** mod-entry-point, harmony-patching, side-screen, mod-strings

| Type | Convention | Example |
|------|------------|---------|
| Mod entry class | `Mod.cs`, class `<Name>Mod : UserMod2` | `BitshifterMod` in `Mod.cs` |
| Harmony patches | `Patches.cs`, or a file named for what is patched | `PlanetoidPatch.cs`, `SettleSimPatch.cs` |
| Building config | `<Building>Config.cs`, class `<Building>Config : IBuildingConfig` with `public const string ID` | `SmartWeightPlateConfig.cs` |
| Side screen | `<Building>SideScreen.cs` | `SmartWeightPlateSideScreen.cs` |
| Components | `<Thing>.cs` named for the component | `FridgeThermostat.cs`, `ZoneStore.cs` |
| Strings | `ModStrings.cs` | `mods/salty-surf/src/SaltySurf/ModStrings.cs` |
| Options | `Options.cs`, class `Options` | `mods/vent-freeze-fix/src/VentFreezeFix/Options.cs` |
| Tests | `<Topic>.cs` in `<Name>.Tests`, one static class per topic | `Reach.cs`, `Gates.cs`, `Persistence.cs`; `Kit.cs` for shared helpers |
| Mod metadata | `mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml` in the project folder | `staticID: "Isochronous.<PascalName>"` |
| Translations | `translations/<locale>.po`, template `<Name>.pot` | `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/translations` |
| Art | `anim/` (kanim files), `assets/` | `bitshifter_ribbon_reader_kanim` |
| Release material | `mods/<name>/publish/`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md` | |

## Code Naming
**Id:** blk-29cccda00da5

### Variables
**Id:** blk-396cf026d230

- camelCase for locals, parameters and private instance fields; no underscore prefix.
- PascalCase for constants (`ArmSeconds`, `Bits`, `TechId`) and for `static readonly` values that act as constants or lookups (`Standard`, `YieldToWorkshopIds`, `Contested`).
- camelCase for private static mutable state and caches (`armed`, `scratch`, `lastGrid`, `symbols`, `anyRows`).
- Descriptive names; single letters only for loop indexes and the `e` of a catch.

```csharp
private const float ArmSeconds = 2f;
private static readonly Dictionary<int, float> armed = new Dictionary<int, float>();
```
(`mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`)

### Functions/Methods
**Id:** blk-74fdfbb5fd77  
**Tags:** harmony-patching

- PascalCase, starting with a verb: `Apply`, `Decide`, `SwapTable`, `CopyRangeFrom`, `ApplyRange`.
- Game callbacks keep the game's names (`OnSpawn`, `OnPrefabInit`, `OnCleanUp`, `Sim1000ms`).
- Harmony methods are named for their kind: `Prefix`, `Postfix`, `Transpiler`, `Finalizer`, plus `Prepare`, `TargetMethod`, `TargetMethods`.

### Classes/Types/Interfaces
**Id:** blk-8e2d093bd3cc  
**Tags:** harmony-patching

- PascalCase nouns. Interfaces take an `I` prefix (`IPlanTab` and `ITabView` in `mods/upgrade-planner`, and the game's own).
- Harmony patch classes: `<PatchedType>_<PatchedMethod>_Patch` (`LogicRibbonReader_GetBitDepth_Patch`, `Db_Initialize_Patch`, `GeneratedBuildings_LoadGeneratedBuildings_Patch`). A patch for a type with one concern may use `<Type>_Patch` (`LiquidVentConfig_Patch`). Patches nested in a holder class may drop the suffix (`Constructable_OnSpawn` in `ReachTablePatches`).
- Classes are `sealed` unless built for inheritance. The mod class is `public sealed`. Types the game does not reach are `internal`.
- Option enums and nested helper types are PascalCase (`CoolPodMode`, `BridgeKind`).

### Booleans
**Id:** blk-8844bcd02963

- Prefix with `Is`, `Has`, `Can`, `Should` or name the state: `IsEnabled`, `OriginalActive`, `isSpawned`, `warnedMissingInternals`.

### Strings (`ModStrings`)
**Id:** blk-081c15a29a2f  
**Tags:** mod-strings

- `ModStrings` mirrors the game's `STRINGS` tree: nested static classes and `LocString` fields in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. `ModStrings.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.<BUILDINGID>.NAME` is registered as `STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.<BUILDINGID>.NAME`, the key the game looks a building name up by (`mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/ModStrings.cs`).
- Mod-private text goes under a branch named for the mod in capitals (`ModStrings.SALTYSURF.ELEMENT_LIST`, `ModStrings.JUMPERBRIDGES.OPTIONS`).
- Option keys are written out as `STRINGS.<MOD>.OPTIONS.<OPTION>.NAME` and `.TOOLTIP`; categories as `STRINGS.<MOD>.OPTIONS.CATEGORY.<NAME>`.
- Long branches are shortened with an alias at the top of the file (`using OPTIONS = NaturalBackwalls.ModStrings.NATURALBACKWALLS.OPTIONS;`).

### Ids and Tags
**Id:** blk-e8a34f4dbe20

- Building ids are PascalCase and match the config class (`SmartWeightPlate`); a mod that replaces another mod's buildings reuses that mod's ids (`StoragePodConfig`, `CoolPodConfig` in `mods/storage-pod-redux`).
- Tags and PAction ids carry a mod prefix: `DetectAnyElement_Any`, `Isochronous.SweepZones.Tool`.
- The `staticID` in `mod.yaml` is `Isochronous.<PascalName>`.
- Test names start with the mod's name or an abbreviation of it: `[OniTest("Bitshifter: a NOT gate on a ribbon inverts every bit")]`, `VFF:` for Vent Freeze Fix.

## Project-Specific Conventions
**Id:** blk-73a9561bde05

### Motion Sensor Range specifics
**Id:** blk-76023d37cf80  
**Tags:** side-screen, mod-strings, in-game-testing, logging

- `ModStrings.UI.UISIDESCREENS.MOTION_SENSOR_RANGE_SIDE_SCREEN` holds the side-screen text.
- Test classes: `Range`, `Detection`, `Persistence` in `src/MotionSensorRange.Tests`.
- Log prefix `[MotionSensorRange]`; `staticID` `Isochronous.MotionSensorRange`.

## Related
**Id:** blk-01c25613162c

- See also: [code style](code-style.md)

sections.title: Files and Directories
sections.text:
## Files and Directories
**Id:** blk-8205431a2930

sections.title: General Rules
sections.text:
### General Rules
**Id:** blk-eb9606adb12e

- A mod lives in `mods/<kebab-case-name>/` (`natural-backwalls-everywhere`, `just-fall-already`).
- Its code is under `mods/<name>/src/<PascalName>/` with a matching `src/<PascalName>.Tests/` project. `AssemblyName`, `RootNamespace` and the project folder share one PascalCase name (`DontCountEggsOnRails`).
- C# files are PascalCase and named for the main type they hold. One concept per file; small related types may share a file (`Display` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`).
- Release tags are `<mod-folder>-v<version>` (repository README).

sections.title: Code Naming
sections.text:
## Code Naming
**Id:** blk-29cccda00da5

sections.title: Variables
sections.text:
### Variables
**Id:** blk-396cf026d230

- camelCase for locals, parameters and private instance fields; no underscore prefix.
- PascalCase for constants (`ArmSeconds`, `Bits`, `TechId`) and for `static readonly` values that act as constants or lookups (`Standard`, `YieldToWorkshopIds`, `Contested`).
- camelCase for private static mutable state and caches (`armed`, `scratch`, `lastGrid`, `symbols`, `anyRows`).
- Descriptive names; single letters only for loop indexes and the `e` of a catch.

```csharp
private const float ArmSeconds = 2f;
private static readonly Dictionary<int, float> armed = new Dictionary<int, float>();
```
(`mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`)

sections.title: Booleans
sections.text:
### Booleans
**Id:** blk-8844bcd02963

- Prefix with `Is`, `Has`, `Can`, `Should` or name the state: `IsEnabled`, `OriginalActive`, `isSpawned`, `warnedMissingInternals`.

sections.title: Ids and Tags
sections.text:
### Ids and Tags
**Id:** blk-e8a34f4dbe20

- Building ids are PascalCase and match the config class (`SmartWeightPlate`); a mod that replaces another mod's buildings reuses that mod's ids (`StoragePodConfig`, `CoolPodConfig` in `mods/storage-pod-redux`).
- Tags and PAction ids carry a mod prefix: `DetectAnyElement_Any`, `Isochronous.SweepZones.Tool`.
- The `staticID` in `mod.yaml` is `Isochronous.<PascalName>`.
- Test names start with the mod's name or an abbreviation of it: `[OniTest("Bitshifter: a NOT gate on a ribbon inverts every bit")]`, `VFF:` for Vent Freeze Fix.
